clauses.scope_note: General user service agreement, §免责声明(2): Baidu may suspend or terminate service when the user violates laws or the agreement; this is a provider permission, not a user restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: user_violates_applicable_law_or_agreement means the user has violated national or local laws or the service agreement.

clauses.scope_note: General user service agreement, §免责声明(3): Baidu may terminate services, disclose the misconduct within Baidu-affiliated sites, and cancel the account; the text also describes possible effects on access to other Baidu services. These are provider permissions, not user duties.
clauses.condition_explanation: user_commits_listed_or_other_serious_service_rule_misconduct means the user engages in fraud, publishes or sells counterfeit or inferior goods, infringes others’ lawful rights, or otherwise seriously violates any Baidu service rule.

clauses.scope_note: General user service agreement, §免责声明(4): using the service signifies acceptance of applicable service guidance and rules; use is stated to be premised on agreeing to follow them. Baidu may unilaterally adjust the rules, which are the prompts shown or messages sent at the time of use.
clauses.condition_explanation: accept_and_follow_current_service_guidance means the user accepts and follows applicable transaction-operation prompts and service rules presented on the relevant page or sent by SMS, telephone, or similar means when using the service.

obligation_items.content: Accept and follow the applicable service guidance and rules presented for use of the service.
obligation_items.object: Baidu intelligent cloud service and its applicable service guidance and rules
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the user uses the service; the applicable guidance and rules are those shown or sent at the time of use.

clauses.scope_note: General user service agreement, §免责声明(5): the user is told to log in to the relevant product-service website in a timely manner during service use to check and perform transaction operations. The clause disclaims provider responsibility for specified missed-notice consequences; that disclaimer is not extracted as a rule.
clauses.condition_explanation: check_relevant_service_website_in_a_timely_manner means timely checking the relevant product-service website during the service process for progress and next-step transaction operations, since email, SMS, and telephone notices may not be received or timely received.

obligation_items.content: Log in to the relevant product-service website in a timely manner to check service progress and perform transaction operations.
obligation_items.object: Relevant product-service website and transaction operations
obligation_items.trigger: During the service process, because electronic notices may not be received or timely received.
